mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of P-glycoprotein (efflux transporter) and UDP-glucuronosyltransferase, significantly reducing dabigatran bioavailability and plasma concentrations by approximately 50-70%.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if anticoagulation is necessary during rifampin therapy, consider alternative anticoagulants (warfarin with INR monitoring or parenteral anticoagulants) or discontinue rifampin if clinically feasible.
